8.39.2.1. iLock_Geography.xconfig.PiSPEC.__init__¶

PiSPEC.__init__(*args)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:args (tuple(str, vtuple(str))|tuple(str, str)) – A tuple containing two elements. If the second element is a tuple, the first element is the name of a PiSPEC parameter and the second element is the signature of the parameter. Otherwise, the first element is the name of a PiSPEC class and the second element is a regex describing how an instantiated PiSPEC object is named.
